summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of WorkMate HU. 10/10 pytest tests pass covering all CRUD endpoints (customers, jobs, quotes, worklogs, documents), company GET/PUT, dashboard aggregation, seed idempotency, quote PDF generation (with verified Hungarian ékezetek: Árvíztűrő, tükörfúrógép, Ügyfél, őű all present in extracted PDF text). Frontend Playwright: dashboard loads with all 4 stat cards, sidebar nav to all 7 modules works, active state visible, sidebar-collapse (264->84px) works, theme-toggle persists across navigation, customer CRUD + search, job create with customer select and kanban view toggle, quote creation with items — totals correctly compute Nettó=2000, ÁFA(27%)=540, Bruttó=2540 — PDF endpoint returns 200 application/pdf, worklog add/save, document category filter, company save persists live. Mobile view (390x844): hamburger opens sidebar correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py crud() generator defines inner endpoint functions with same names via decorators — FastAPI keys by path so it's fine, but names shadow across iterations; low risk.
Frontend Shell.jsx uses external Unsplash image for user avatar — external dependency; consider local asset.
Company model: id defaulted to 'company' string; PUT payload accepts the whole Company model, so client could theoretically change id — server force-overrides to 'company', so safe.
No pagination/limit on list endpoints — 1000 hard limit is fine for MVP.
PDF endpoint reloads DejaVu font per request; could be cached at module load.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed (idempotent) — 3 customers, 4 jobs, 2 quotes, 3 worklogs, 3 documents, company profile created. Additional TEST_UI records created via UI and left in DB (safe, prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and core UI flows verified green. If retesting, run pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Hungarian character rendering in PDF is validated using pypdf extract.
